definitions.gloss: many years; a long period; long service
definitions.explanation: A long span of years. Most often seen in set expressions praising long, continuous service or membership, and in formal or written contexts rather than everyday speech.

examples.japanese: {永年|えいねん}の{夢|ゆめ}がかなった。
{永年|えいねん}{勤続|きんぞく}の{表彰|ひょうしょう}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: He received an award for long years of service.

examples.japanese: {永年|えいねん}にわたって{地域|ちいき}の{活動|かつどう}を{支|ささ}えてきた。
examples.english: She has supported the community's activities for many years.

notes:
A formal, largely written word meaning "long years." It appears mostly in fixed expressions rather than as a free noun in conversation, where {長年|ながねん} is preferred.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {永年|えいねん}{勤続|きんぞく}: long service (at a company)
- {永年|えいねん}{会員|かいいん}: long-standing member
- {永年|えいねん}にわたって: over many years

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {長年|ながねん}: many years — the everyday word; interchangeable in most sentences and far more common in speech
- {永久|えいきゅう}: permanence, eternity — stresses "forever," not just "a long time"
